title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Check posting date before posting (preview posting) in the sales and purchase documents – Customization
summary: A custom codeunit checks whether the posting date on a sales or purchase document is in the current month. If it is not, a confirmation dialog asks the user whether to post anyway, for both regular and preview posting. It uses event subscribers on codeunit 81 Sales-Post (Yes/No) and codeunit 91 Purch.-Post (Yes/No).
key_points: Standard posting periods (Allow Posting From/To in General Ledger Setup or User Setup) cannot ask for confirmation when the date is outside the current month, so this needs a customization
Sales uses OnBeforeConfirmPost and OnRunPreviewOnAfterSetPostingFlags in codeunit 81 Sales-Post (Yes/No)
Purchases use OnBeforeConfirmPost and OnRunPreviewOnBeforePurchPostRun in codeunit 91 Purch.-Post (Yes/No)
The check uses CalcDate to work out the start and end of the current month from Today (which can be swapped for Workdate), then calls Confirm and raises an empty Error if the user declines
The same approach can add other checks before posting, such as required fields

quotes.text: This is just a simple example, you can also use the same method to add other controls, such as required fields, etc.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that this event subscriber pattern is reusable for implementing additional business rule validations
